discovery_notes: Search-snippet leads only. Shanghai has no pin branded '3rd anniversary' found; June 2019 Fun Day is the anniversary-period release. HKDL Graduation 2019 pins and Chip n Dale 2019 pin were posted Nov/Dec 2018 (likely 2018 releases) - excluded. Mickey Music Festival SHDR is 2020 - excluded. HKDL castle transformation tied to monthly princess pins; an LE150 Castle of Magical Dreams frame seen only on a collection site, not recorded. Reseller (dpinstore, yourwdwstore, usshoppingsos, fryguypins) data not used. Pin Trader Club Oct 2019 HKDL list is single-source.
